mentions.name: Property tax exemption compliance software
mentions.description: A platform built for a non-profit that manages property tax exemption compliance for 70+ property managers across North and South Carolina, some managing 10,000+ units. It accepts varied Excel/CSV data exports from Entrata, Yardi, and manually managed spreadsheets and normalizes them into a fixed expected format for tax compliance; the author also onboards property managers and handles development and support remotely.
mentions.problem: Only part of property managers' source data is needed for tax compliance, and upstream data is frequently missing or poorly managed.
mentions.audience: 70+ property managers in North Carolina and South Carolina, served on behalf of a non-profit client
mentions.source_excerpt: They are a non profit and have a software (that I build) to manage property tax exemption compliance.
mentions.author: brainless
